name: Elegant Floriculture & Agrotech (India) Limited
about: Elegant Floriculture & Agrotech (India) Limited cultivates, produces, and sells flowers in India. It offers indoor plants, such as alfenia, anthurium, croton, zamiocolis, aglaonema, orchids, and others. The company also offers Dutch rose flowers and Gerbera flowers. Elegant Floriculture & Agrotech (India) Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.
